ideas.title: Investigating Child Care Assistance Cuts
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of child care assistance cuts on families and providers, including the handling of the day care fraud scandal in Minnesota.
questions: What are the consequences of child care assistance cuts for families and providers?
How is the day care fraud scandal in Minnesota being handled?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for greater transparency and accountability in the handling of child care assistance funds.
